# Wade Kerzie

> Founder of Kerzie AI Solutions, McKinney, Texas. 30+ years of enterprise sales leadership ($420M+ career revenue, nine deals over $12M), now building and selling AI products that are in production with paying clients. Published in Nation's Restaurant News, LawFuel and Small Business Currents. Applied AI Competency Index 98/100 (Verified Architect).

## Products in production
- [GotaGuy](https://gotaguy.chat): home repair by text; live in McKinney, TX and Aurora, CO
- [The Back Cover](https://kerzie.ai/back-cover): AI-search readiness for local businesses; live for a GMC dealer with a daily inventory refresh, public log at https://kerzie.ai/shortline-log
- [Unison](https://kerzie.ai/ventures/unison): omnichannel lead response for small businesses
- [TrueSeat](https://trueseat.io): AI interview to candidate dossier, hosted at a URL
